findings.title: `include_website_name` lacks the `?` suffix, so the serializer never uses it as a filter.
findings.body: ActiveModel::Serializers only checks methods named `include_<attr>?`, like the `include_card_image_badge_id?` method just below. Because this one is named `include_website_name` without the `?`, it is never called. As a result, `website_name` is sent for every user, as `null` when there is no website, instead of being left out. Rename it to `include_website_name?`.

findings.title: Host comparisons are case-sensitive, so mixed-case website URLs never match the instance domain.
findings.body: `URI(...).host` keeps the case the user typed. A website like `http://Example.com/user` on the instance `example.com` fails the `==`, split and `ends_with?` checks. The profile then shows only `Example.com` without the path, which is the case this change sets out to fix. Downcase both hosts before comparing them, e.g. `website_host = URI(website.to_s).host.try(:downcase) rescue nil` and `discourse_host = Discourse.current_hostname.downcase`.
